text:
sara: heads-up — planning a config-only push tonight 00:45 UTC. target: prod global, staged roll. changes: shaping.soft_floor 0.88 -> 0.82, tenant_default_cap 130r/s -> 95r/s, batching.target_msgs 20 -> 10, global_rpc_timeout_ms 15000 -> 11000. routing pinned to 'nimble-shim' policy during rollout. canary in us-west1 for 12m.

jason: noted. what are the failure gates?

sara: rollback if p95 > baseline*1.35 OR p99 > baseline*1.3 for 10m, or 5xx > 0.6% sustained for 5m. also stop if kvcache_evictions/spike > 250 on any host.

mino: I'll wire a short-lived probe hitting top long-seq routes every 10s and add inflight queue and token/sec panels.

release-bot: [scheduled] config-only::cfg-2026-04-15-A -> canary(us-west1) at 1741234800

sre-ella: recommend kvcache_warm_ms=9000 on canary hosts for 4m to reduce churn.

deploy-bot: [canary apply] cfg-2026-04-15-A applied to us-west1 at 1741234830

sara: applied to staging earlier — small improvement in short-seq p95, slight throughput regressions on long-seq in staging. worth watching.

deploy-bot: [canary metrics] at 1741234890 p95: 220ms (base 195ms), p99: 890ms (base 820ms), 5xx: 0.03%

jason: that p99 bump is okay under our gate. recommend slow ramp: 3% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100% with manual sign-offs. ops-Dan ok?

ops-dan: agree. manual gates at each stage. hold if any kvcache signal or tenant-specific error increase.

deploy-bot: [rollout] -> 3% at 1741234950

sre-ella: alert: evictions spike on eu-north hosts at 1741234988 tied to tenant-alpha. p99 there climbed to 1.6s.

mino: pause ramp. setting routing fallback for eu-north to previous config now.

ops-dan: paused. folks, prepare per-route override for tenant-alpha if needed.

sara: tenant-alpha uses very long sequences; smaller batches likely increased kv churn. I'll prepare per-route exception: batching.target_msgs=20 and tenant_cap=200 for tenant-alpha.

deploy-bot: [hotfix apply] per-route override for tenant-alpha -> pushed to eu-north at 1741235060

sre-ella: post-hotfix: eu-north p99 back to 760ms, 5xx normal. good signal.

jason: decision: do not rollback globally. keep global knobs but add per-route exception for long-seq tenants. update runbook to list per-route override as first mitigation.

ops-dan: resume ramp after 8m hold: continue from 3% -> 10%.

deploy-bot: [rollout resumed] -> 10% at 1741235100

sara: adding release note draft: "Config-only update to tighten shaping and reduce tail variance. Per-tenant exceptions applied for long-sequence workloads to prevent kv churn. Rollout tag: cfg-2026-04-15-A."

jason: :thumbsup: once 100% + 30m healthy post summary to #announcements. good run team.

deploy-bot: [status] current tag cfg-2026-04-15-A, at 10% as of 1741235127"
